title: Meta-labeling size tilt on Stop-hunt trend inducement (L2 logistic, rank map x0.5-x1.5)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: can quant / ML meta-labeling (learn when a signal is likely to win, size it up or down) improve the strategies?
verdict: OOS AUC 0.475 (2026 H2 frozen 0.529); best model of the family rf_all AUC 0.527 permutation p 0.5446 (H2 0.703). 2021-25 n=408 net +32,681 vs flat +39,733, 2-wk 0.3/1.5 vs 0.6/0.7, beats random sizing in 3.0%; 2026 H2 n=24 net +5,020 vs flat +4,916, 2-wk 0.0/0.0 vs 0.0/0.0, beats random sizing in 41.5%. Strict pass: False.
notes: tools/meta_label.py; research/quant/meta/sh_trend.json; sized at the strategy's own size rule x the multiplier (P&L linear in micros); trades = walk-forward OOS span trades (untested months at x1).

params.map: m = 0.5 + percentile of p among the training predictions

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
